name: UF-ega-night-scene
note: Night exteriors: deep EGA blue skies. (night:1.4) emphasis + LoRA 0.65 — at full strength ega_art paints daylight. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/ega-night-scene.  (sample: seed 1317)

form.subject: (night:1.4), a (castle on a cliff:1.2) under a (dark blue starry night sky:1.3), full moon, lit windows, winding road, black mountain silhouettes
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (daylight, sun, bright day, daytime:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon '(night:1.4), a (castle on a cliff:1.2) under a (dark blue starry night sky:1.3), full moon, lit windows, winding road, black mountain silhouettes, ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, scene background, role-playing game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.65 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (daylight, sun, bright day, daytime:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette EGA --dither bayer4 --dither-amount 0.4 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 3 --pixel-angles 1.25 --seed 1317
